Kraa! What a curious box, warrior. The voices of skalds slumber inside, yet it stays mute.

Give it a voice, and it will follow you on any journey.

Now the songs follow at your heels. In a pack or a chest the box falls silent — music needs air.

They say some of its beats make even your foes tremble.
